args.message:
Fix FIN-212: use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money

The docstring specified ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212, but the
implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP, causing test_money.py to fail
(e.g. 2.665 rounded to 2.67 instead of 2.66).

args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix FIN-212: implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money
args.body:
## Summary
- `src/money.py` documented banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212, but the implementation actually used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, causing the nightly build failure in `tests/test_money.py` (e.g. `2.665` rounded to `2.67` instead of the expected `2.66`).
- This change switches the quantize call to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` to match the spec and the tests.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` passed on commit `08d3cd5986`.
